commits.subject: FSType 0
commits.body:
Installable embedding. The value exists only in the release: google/fonts
8ccda7bf7 (2015-08-05, "Fix fsType for 40 font files") changed the shipped
binary from 4 to 0. This source, and the binary FontForge exported from it,
state 4 (preview & print). The OFL shipped with the font already permits
embedding.
